progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Dk in Hesar. Zarbi (0:17.8) introduces Gk, Bb, C, Db, F, centred on Dk. The line peaks at Gk4 (387.6 Hz) at 2:12.5. It closes on the tonic (Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Gk4 → Eb4 → Gk4).
